preservation.note: Sparse worktree body unavailable; no equality claim.

conclusions.finding: fitBoardRect preserves each finite positive board aspect ratio. Each observed arena is relative, explicitly unpadded and remains an existing minmax grid slot; the centered absolutely positioned canvas cannot determine that slot intrinsic size. CSS starts at zero and helper writes only fitted child width/height. Existing contain/nearest sampling remains unchanged.

Host passes each seat cached width through the existing displayCSSWidth option. Geometry refresh follows setting both internal bitmap sizes; updateMenu refreshes only when boards visibility, actual pad visibility or body text settings change. Ordinary frames read cheap state/cache values only. RO delivers subsequent content-box reflows without a frame-loop layout read.

Helper observer closures are generation-fenced. Persisted pagehide suspends/disconnects; pageshow reinstalls one observer and refreshes without gameplay calls. Terminal disposal removes resize/pagehide/pageshow listeners and rejects old callbacks. The host outer releaseArtwork now calls helper disposal, so post-creation startup failures that enter the existing catch also reach cleanup.

Invalid/zero measurement clears the CSS footprint and returns undefined renderer width. It does not pass zero or NaN as a usable scale, and positive deliveries recover. In absence of RO, explicit board/layout refresh and window resize remain supported; no claim is made that an old browser without RO observes every asynchronous font/content change.

The initial string-serialization concern is resolved with cached numeric width/height and initialized state. A new source test models browser-normalized style strings and repeated fractional deliveries. No test execution was performed by this reviewer.

Runtime delta does not modify match/simulation, input, score, actor, artwork, picture ownership or controller routing functions. Guide documents fitting versus authored image fitting, restoration, native qualification and the independent 64-logical-pixel cap at 240 CSS width. It does not claim a completed public release or new same-attempt Versus Retry.

evidenceLimits: Read-only source/hunk review; no tests, native browser, physical devices, build, remote, index or version changes by this lane.
Actual-host fixture/tests were still being completed by their separate owner and were not included in this review.
CSS layout feedback, gutter appearance and player recognition require actual native verification; source absence of intrinsic feedback is not a browser-performance measurement.
Guide/source acceptance here does not qualify a release, all viewport readability, P08-A/P08-B completion or source gates.
The independent 64-logical-pixel cap remains: correct fit width alone yields 13.33 CSS px for an ordinary enemy on a 240-CSS-pixel wide 1152-pixel board.
